problems.formal_statement:
theorem OAI.PiExponent.tendsto_log_translationTermCount_div (m : ℕ) {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) :
    Tendsto (fun H : ℝ => Real.log (translationTermCount m v H : ℝ) / H)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  sorry
problems.natural_language_statement: For every natural number $m$ and real $v>0$, the translation count $T_m(v,H)$ has polynomial growth of degree $2m+1$, hence $$\frac{\log T_m(v,H)}{H}\longrightarrow 0$$ as $H\to+\infty$. The source proof first establishes the positive normalized limit $T_m(v,H)/H^{2m+1}\to 1/v$ from the floor-count limits and then applies the accepted logarithm-of-polynomial-growth theorem.
